<info added on 2025-07-17T16:38:46.722Z>
✅ **Jinja2 Syntax Highlighting Implementation Complete**

**What I accomplished:**
- Successfully integrated Monaco Editor with custom Jinja2 language definition
- Implemented comprehensive syntax highlighting for Jinja2 templates:
  - `{{ variable }}` patterns highlighted in pink/magenta with bold formatting
  - `{% tag %}` patterns highlighted in teal for control structures  
  - `{# comment #}` patterns highlighted in gray with italic formatting
  - String literals highlighted in light green
  - Numbers highlighted in yellow
- Created custom 'jinja2-theme' based on VS Code dark theme
- Applied theme automatically when editor mounts
- Both System and User prompt editors now support full Jinja2 syntax highlighting

**Technical implementation:**
- Used Monaco's `setMonarchTokensProvider` for custom language tokenization
- Defined regex patterns for all Jinja2 syntax elements
- Created semantic token mapping (variable, tag, comment, string, number)
- Applied custom color scheme that's easy to read and distinguish

**Testing:**
- Default template includes `{{ name }}` and `{{ task }}` variables which are properly highlighted
- Variables display in bold pink, clearly distinguishable from regular text
- Ready for user testing with various Jinja2 template patterns

✅ This subtask is essentially complete and working perfectly!

subtasks.title: Integrate Variable Detection

subtasks.details:
Develop functionality to detect and highlight variables within Jinja2 templates, aiding in template debugging.
<info added on 2025-07-17T16:39:20.026Z>
✅ **Variable Detection Implementation Complete**

**What I accomplished:**
- Implemented real-time variable detection using regex pattern matching
- Created extractVariables function that scans both System and User prompts
- Regex pattern: `/\{\{\s*([a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*)\s*\}\}/g` captures Jinja2 variables
- Automatic deduplication of variables across both editors
- Real-time updates when prompt content changes via useEffect hook

**UI Implementation:**
- Collapsible Variables panel at bottom of editor area
- Dynamic badge showing variable count
- Auto-generated input fields for each detected variable
- Grid layout (responsive 1-3 columns) for variable inputs
- Empty state with helpful message when no variables detected
- Proper labeling and placeholder text for user guidance

**Technical Features:**
- State management with React useState for detected variables
- Real-time parsing triggered on every editor content change
- Clean variable name extraction (strips whitespace, validates naming)
- Supports standard Jinja2 variable naming conventions
- Ready for integration with prompt execution system

**Testing:**
- Default template with `{{ name }}` and `{{ task }}` variables properly detected
- Variables panel updates dynamically as user types
- Input fields generate correctly with proper labels
- Empty state displays when variables are removed

✅ Variable detection is fully functional and ready for the next phase!
</info added on 2025-07-17T16:39:20.026Z>

tasks.title: Develop Variable Extraction Feature
tasks.description: Implement automatic detection and input generation for Jinja2 variables.
tasks.details: Parse the Jinja2 templates to detect variables and dynamically generate input fields for each detected variable. Use React Hook Form for managing form state and validation with Zod.
tasks.testStrategy: Create test cases with templates containing variables and verify that input fields are generated correctly.

tasks.title: Create Model Selection Dropdown
tasks.description: Develop a dropdown for selecting LLM models, starting with OpenAI models.
tasks.details: Implement a dropdown component using Shadcn UI that lists available OpenAI models (e.g., GPT-4, GPT-3.5). Ensure the dropdown is easily extendable for future models.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that the dropdown displays the correct models and updates the selected model state correctly.

tasks.title: Implement Settings Modal
tasks.description: Create a modal for configuring model settings and API keys.
tasks.details: Develop a settings modal using Shadcn UI that allows users to configure model settings such as temperature and max length. Include a secure input for storing the OpenAI API key in localStorage.
tasks.testStrategy: Test the modal for correct display and functionality, ensuring settings are saved and retrieved correctly.

tasks.title: Develop Run/Stop Execution Feature
tasks.description: Implement functionality to execute prompts and display results.
tasks.details: Create a prominent Run button that triggers prompt execution via OpenAI API. Implement a stop feature to cancel ongoing requests. Display results with syntax highlighting and execution stats.
tasks.testStrategy: Test prompt execution with various inputs and verify that results are displayed correctly. Ensure the stop feature works as expected.

tasks.title: Design Results Display Panel
tasks.description: Develop a panel to display prompt execution results with history and stats.
tasks.details: Implement a results panel that shows execution history with timestamps, token usage, and latency stats. Include a copy feature for results.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that results are displayed with correct formatting and stats. Test the copy feature for accuracy.

tasks.title: Implement Sharing Functionality
tasks.description: Enable users to share prompt sessions via unique URLs.
tasks.details: Develop a feature to generate unique URLs that encode the current session state. Use URL fragments or a lightweight backend for session data storage.
tasks.testStrategy: Test URL generation and ensure that visiting the URL restores the session state accurately.

tasks.title: Create Test & Evaluate Panel
tasks.description: Develop a panel for managing test cases and variable combinations.
tasks.details: Implement a right-side panel that allows users to add, edit, and run test cases with different variable sets. Include contextual help and sample data.
tasks.testStrategy: Test the panel's functionality by creating and running multiple test cases. Verify that variable combinations are handled correctly.

tasks.title: Develop Left Navigation Panel
tasks.description: Implement a collapsible left navigation panel for prompt management.
tasks.details: Create a left navigation panel with branding, prompt list, and utility icons. Ensure it is collapsible for workspace efficiency.
tasks.testStrategy: Test the panel's expand/collapse functionality and verify that navigation links work correctly.

tasks.title: Implement Persistent Settings Storage
tasks.description: Store user settings and API keys securely in the browser.
tasks.details: Use localStorage or Encrypted IndexedDB to store user settings and API keys securely. Ensure data is never transmitted externally without consent.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that settings are stored and retrieved correctly across sessions. Test security measures to ensure data privacy.

tasks.title: Develop Real-time Collaboration Feature
tasks.description: Enable real-time collaboration for prompt editing and execution.
tasks.details: Implement real-time session synchronization using WebSockets or peer-to-peer connections. Ensure optimistic concurrency for conflict resolution.
tasks.testStrategy: Test real-time collaboration with multiple users editing and executing prompts simultaneously. Verify session synchronization accuracy.

tasks.title: Implement Session Management
tasks.description: Manage session lifecycle and expiration for temporary sessions.
tasks.details: Develop logic to automatically expire temporary sessions after a period of inactivity. Allow configuration of expiration settings.
tasks.testStrategy: Test session expiration by simulating inactivity and verifying session termination.

tasks.title: Design Responsive UI Layout
tasks.description: Ensure the application layout is responsive and accessible.
tasks.details: Use TailwindCSS to create a responsive layout that adapts to various screen sizes. Implement keyboard navigation support for accessibility.
tasks.testStrategy: Test the application on different devices and screen sizes to ensure responsive behavior. Verify keyboard navigation functionality.
